model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of completions and coverage for different language models. The x-axis is labeled “Number of completions (k)” and has a logarithmic scale, ranging from 2⁰ to 2⁸, with tick labels at each power of 2. The y-axis is labeled “Coverage” and has a linear scale, ranging from 0.2 to 0.9, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. A dark blue line with circular markers represents “Llama-3B”, starting at approximately 0.38 when the number of completions is 2⁰ and increasing to approximately 0.84 when the number of completions is 2⁸. A dark green dashed line represents “Llama-3B + FT”, starting at approximately 0.32 when the number of completions is 2⁰ and increasing to approximately 0.78 when the number of completions is 2⁸. A light blue line with triangular markers represents “Llama-1B”, starting at approximately 0.28 when the number of completions is 2⁰ and increasing to approximately 0.72 when the number of completions is 2⁸. A light green dashed line with diamond markers represents “Llama-1B + FT”, starting at approximately 0.23 when the number of completions is 2⁰ and increasing to approximately 0.66 when the number of completions is 2⁸.
